references.text: Both verses illustrate God's will to preserve His people by following a specific instruction (stay in the land/go to Egypt) to avoid destruction.
Connects the prayer's content about deliverance from famine with its concrete historical fulfillment through Joseph.
Creates a deep narrative contrast between salvation by going to Egypt (Genesis) and destruction by going there later (Jeremiah).
Clear narrative parallel: A prophetic warning of prolonged famine and instruction to move the entire family to survive.
